title: 🤝 Closing the Deal — NDRC 1
foot: 🤝 NDRC 1 · Closing the Deal — B1–B2 · self-marking 🤝
story: Emma has worked in the sales team of a software company for two years. Her job: turning prospects into customers. Since January, she has contacted more than 80 companies, and she has already signed 12 contracts.

Last Tuesday, she sent a quote to a transport company in Lyon. The prospect wanted a better price, so yesterday Emma called him. He said: “Your competitor is cheaper.” Emma answered: “Maybe, but our service is more reliable, and our deadlines are shorter.” She offered a 5% discount for a two-year contract.

This morning, the prospect hasn't answered yet. Emma has just written a follow-up email: “Have you received our new offer? I can call you tomorrow at 10 a.m.” Her manager says a good salesperson must listen more than they talk — and should never sound desperate. The deadline for closing the deal is Friday. 🤝

sections.name: TR Traduction
sections.heading: Traduis : present perfect ou prétérit ?
sections.instr: Lis la phrase française et choisis la bonne traduction anglaise. Le repère de temps te dit quel temps utiliser.

items.text: « Depuis janvier, Emma a signé 12 contrats. »
options: Since January, Emma has signed 12 contracts.
items.answer: Since January, Emma has signed 12 contracts.

items.text: « Hier, elle a appelé le prospect. »
options: Yesterday, she has called the prospect.

items.text: « Nous travaillons avec ce client depuis 2023. »
options: We have worked with this client since 2023.
We worked with this client since 2023.
items.answer: We have worked with this client since 2023.

items.text: « Le prospect n'a pas encore répondu. »
« Il y a deux ans, elle a décroché son premier contrat. »
options: Two years ago, she won her first contract.
Two years ago, she has won her first contract.
items.answer: Two years ago, she won her first contract.

items.text: « As-tu déjà négocié avec ce client ? »
options: Have you ever negotiated with this client?
Did you ever negotiated with this client?
items.answer: Have you ever negotiated with this client?

items.text: « La semaine dernière, nous avons offert une remise. »
options: Last week, we offered a discount.
Last week, we have offered a discount.
items.answer: Last week, we offered a discount.

items.text: « Nous n'avons pas encore reçu le devis. »
options: We haven't received the quote yet.
We didn't receive the quote yet.
items.answer: We haven't received the quote yet.
